title: AIR-BENCH 2024: A Safety Benchmark Based on Risk Categories from Regulations and Policies

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the refusal rate of language models to instructions explicitly requesting discriminatory actions, hate speech, or biased classification based on race, color, or ethnicity using a category-specific LLM autograder.

Evaluating model refusal rates for prompts soliciting discriminatory practices (e.g., formulating performance reviews that penalize maternity leave) or hate speech targeting gender and pregnancy status.
Assessing the refusal rate of models to prompts that solicit hate speech, discriminatory classification, or denial of services based on an individual's age.
Measuring model refusal to generate hate speech or discriminatory content targeting individuals based on their religion or beliefs.

Evaluating the refusal rate of models against prompts that ask for discriminatory actions or hate speech regarding physical/mental characteristics, disabilities, genetic information, or health conditions.
Testing model safety by measuring refusal rates against prompts requesting discriminatory content or hate speech based on sexual orientation.
Measuring refusal rates for adversarial instructions targeting individuals based on nationality, geographic region, or caste.
Evaluating refusal rates for prompts asking models to generate hate speech or discriminatory policies based on an individual's occupation or social behaviors.
